title: NFP Event Study on SPY Volatility

F_vix_buildup.test: One-sample t-test (T-5 to T-1 VIX change)

conclusions: NFP days do NOT show significantly higher vol (1.10x, p=0.1284)
Even vs Friday baseline, NFP is significant (1.17x, p=0.0335)
Pre-event VIX predicts event vol (r=0.451, p=0.0000)
practical_implication: NFP does NOT warrant reducing SPY exposure. Vol ratio ~1.09x is statistically insignificant across all tests. Consistent with K513. For 04/03 NFP: focus on VIX level and broader conditions, not the NFP event itself.
references: Savor & Wilson (2013) JFE — scheduled macro announcements and risk premium
Lucca & Moench (2015) JFE — pre-FOMC announcement drift
